precepts.why:
John says “believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God”. And everybody that picks up a Bible is not called or sent by God. Some picked up that Bible because they were before ordained, to prove you: “For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation”. That is their lot. God created them for this reason, to be a proving ground for you: are you going to follow man, or the word of God?

They are “ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness”. The grace of God is us being called into this truth, knowing that we are Israelites. So if these men come to you saying they speak on behalf of God, but most of their conversation is being the sidekick to the Diddler and the Hebrew Hammer, selling their body, oily pecs, then you have to question: are these men really sent by God, or are they ordained to try me?

That is why the Bible warns us to try the spirits, and the way to try them is by these scriptures. Are they living up to the scriptures? Are they speaking according to what the scriptures say? Or are they men of old ordained to draw you away? Examine that, brothers and sisters. And it isn't only them; it is for anybody who says they believe in Christ and the Bible and calls themselves an Israelite, and for the Christian pastors too, because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

“The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge”. You show your fear of the Lord, and that you have knowledge, by sitting down and reading, as Isaiah says, “Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read”. But these men have no Bibles in front of them. Everything is made up off the top of the dome, full of pride and lasciviousness. There is no fear of the Lord there.

And “fools despise wisdom and instruction.” They won't follow wisdom, won't follow basic instructions, won't look in the book. Everything is of the flesh, their sensual, carnal side. He goes on podcast interviews and freestyles the whole thing, and nothing biblical comes out.

But people see him say he's an Israelite and equate that to all Israelites. See the chess move: Satan puts these things in place because somebody is going to add affliction to our bonds. So we are not going to sit back. We will say something, and that goes for the so-called Christians and for brothers in this truth, Israelites alike. We will correct all folly, and we won't be partial with it. Try the spirits by the book.

precepts.text: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar. He who loveth God loveth his brother also. What the white man calls patriotism among his people we must practise among ours: God and race.
precepts.point: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light and there is none occasion of stumbling in him; he that hateth his brother walketh in darkness, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes. Hate of your brother blinds you to deep but basic scriptures.

note.label: The Dividing Hatred: the Grafted in Strangers

precepts.why:
John says it again in his fourth chapter: “If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?” And: “this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.”

You can't love one and hate the other. It is impossible. If you love your brother, by default you love God; if you love God, by default you love your brother. They go hand in hand: God and people, God and race. What the white man promotes among his people is what we should promote among ourselves. When we say it, we're called racist; when they say it, they're patriots.

That is the light and darkness of 1 John 2. “He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.” Picture our people in captivity, while the ones who enslaved us rule. For hundreds of years they spent billions, even trillions, to hide our history from us. They tortured us, beat us, raped us, castrated us, and broke us physically, mentally, psychologically and spiritually. Their ruling is their heaven; we are in hell. And an Israelite in that hell spends himself teaching the heathen the access he has to our heaven. That is hate. You hate your people and you hate yourself, and for that you are in darkness.

Esau does not forget. He holds grudges: when they took Maduro, rumor has it they bombed the mausoleum where Hugo Chavez is buried, because Chavez spoke ill of America. But Jacob forgets, even in the midst of captivity. The man who says he loves God while caring more for his oppressor than for his own brother is, in John's own word, a liar.

precepts.why:
Still dealing with where also our Lord was crucified, in Babylon. “Beloved, believe not every spirit,” You read that and the first thing people do: yeah, that's you, we ain't supposed to believe you black Negroes. Really? Let's keep reading. “but try the spirits whether they are of God:” How do you try the spirits? You go into the writings of God, the words of God. “because many false prophets are gone out into the world.” They say, see, that's you black men; even in Uganda, in Africa, that is what they say. Read on. “Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:” Stop. So we say, you confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh? Yes, my brother. What colour was his flesh? Then about thirty minutes of silence, because whatever answer you give you better prove it in the Bible. If you say white, give me a scripture that says that; you say black? Yeah, the Bible said it: Revelation 1:14-15. Now he is silent and angry; the spell is starting to wear off, shaking his head like I've been under a spell.

“And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh” You don't confess that he came in the flesh that Revelation 1:14-15 describes. The white man didn't confess that flesh: from 1453 on up they came with a new Jesus, a pink-skinned, yellow-haired, blue-eyed Jesus. They don't want the woolly-haired, black-skinned Jesus; no, not that flesh. “is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist,” That is Christianity: that is the spirit of antichrist. They go around with a pink-skinned, blue-eyed, yellow-haired Jesus; that is not biblical, that is the spirit of antichrist. Anti means to be against: they are against the woolly-haired Jesus with skin like it burned in the furnace; we don't want that, we don't accept that; therefore you are antichrist. “whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.”

So in Babylon, where also our Lord was crucified: this ain't the real Jerusalem, but spiritually it is, because our people go, crucify him, crucify him. We say he's black, he looks like you; they go, kill that image, crucify it. It is the same analogy: the white man is the one that actually put Christ up on the cross, and the white man is the one that changed his image, and our people yell crucify; they don't want that black-skinned, woolly-haired Jesus.

Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God.

Flesh represents nationality. You could tell a Chinese person when you see a Chinese person in the flesh. You could tell a white man when you see a white man in the flesh. You could tell a black man when you see a black man in the flesh. So to teach Jesus Christ came in the flesh, you are saying that Jesus Christ is a black man. He came from the so-called Negroes that you enslaved.

Like for instance, Malcolm X came on this earth. Martin Luther King, they came on this earth and they came in the flesh. Does it matter what colour Malcolm X was? Does it matter what colour Martin Luther King was? Yes, it does matter, because they came and they were fighting for the struggle of a race of people, for their people and their race. It is the same thing with Christ. Christ came to redeem his people from their sins. So the question is, who is Christ's people? If you could change Christ's people, you could change Christ's teachings. They crafted the counsel.

And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world. If you do not confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh, you are not of God.

Now, what was happening back then? You had the religious leaders that were denying that Jesus Christ, the son of God, came in the flesh, and John was rebuking them, letting them know they are not of God. And they were considered antichrist back then.

Now, to bring it up to today. When it says Jesus Christ came in the flesh, it means Jesus Christ was born through a mother and a father. It means that Jesus Christ had an earthly body, meaning he came from an ethnic group of people. Now what people did Christ come from? He came from Negroes. What colour was Christ's skin? It was black. So does Christianity teach that Jesus Christ came in the flesh? No, they do not. The white man does not teach that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. Matter of fact, they changed Jesus.

So if you do not teach that Jesus Christ was a black man, you are not of God. And this is that spirit of antichrist. You are the antichrist. You are against Christ if you are teaching that Christ had no colour. Because some of these Christians say that Jesus Christ had no colour, Jesus Christ is a spirit. You are of that antichrist. You are against Christ. You hate yourself. You hate your people. And you hate your king.

Believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God, because many false prophets are gone out into the world. You try them with the Bible. That goes for the Christian church too, and for anyone who says he believes on Christ and calls himself an Israelite.
